summary: The recall of Impala gel nail polish products due to the prohibited substance TPO has been reported by Brazil's health regulator ANVISA and summarized by the GlobalCosIng compliance platform. Both sources confirm that all batches of the five listed Impala gel nail polish products are affected.

batch_numbers: Topcoat Gel Impala Gel Plus Clear
findings.evidence_quote: On March 16, 2026, the Brazilian Health Regulatory Agency (Anvisa) announced the recall of all batches of five types of gel nail polishes containing TPO.
